text:
Priya N: Quick sync — we need to decide allowlist vs per-customer quotas for onramp customers. Sales are asking for flexible exceptions; SRE wants predictable hard limits.
Ben - Product: What's the main risk with allowlist? My read: operational complexity, audit gaps, and billing ambiguity.
Jorge M: Quotas give clear billing and automation. Allowlist gives speed for sales but accumulates tech debt.
Evelyn C (sales): Customers keep asking for 'soft limits' — warn them first, only throttle after a grace window. Is that something we can promise? :raised_hands: 
Sam W (eng): Rough eng estimate: allowlist + manual override UI ~3 sprints for an MVP. Full quotas + metering automation ~5 sprints and more infra work.
Priya N: Proposed launch criteria: 1) billing mapping tests, 2) per-customer usage export, 3) audit trail for overrides, 4) documented SLA behavior.
Jorge M: Compromise proposal: make quotas the canonical control, but add configurable "grace window" per customer that behaves as a softguard. That should satisfy sales without heavy manual ops.
Ben - Product: Agree. Need to pick sane defaults: 30d grace for PLG accounts? 72h for short trials?
Evelyn C (sales): 30d ok for PLG. Enterprise often asks for 90d in onboarding clauses. We should allow contract-level overrides but require legal signoff for >60d.
Priya N: Noted. Also: Private deployment customers frequently require hard caps in contracts for compliance — legal will push for hardcaps by default for Private.
Sam W (eng): Technical approach: policy matrix keyed by (environment, customer_tier, product_pack) -> behavior (THROTTLE / SOFTGUARD / ALLOWLIST). Example config: ```{
  "hosted": {"startup": "SOFTGUARD_30d", "enterprise": "THROTTLE_72h"},
  "private": {"*": "THROTTLE_HARDCAP"}
}```
Jorge M: Observability ask: per-route and per-customer breakdown in Console + alerts when grace consumption >50% of contracted baseline. We need surfaced signals for CS and Sales.
Ben - Product: Draft launch checklist: dev complete, e2e billing tests, migration plan for existing burst-credit customers, product docs, sales playbook, legal signoff matrix. Owner: Priya. ETA if prioritized: ~8 weeks for v1.
Evelyn C (sales): I'll pull a prioritized list of 6 customers to offer early opt-in. Need the migration/cutover script for customers using legacy burst credits.
Priya N: Decision summary (captured here so we can move): quotas are canonical control; implement configurable softguard grace windows; provide allowlist as emergency/manual override; Private defaults to hard caps.
Priya N: Action items:
  - Sam W: prototype policy matrix + UI for overrides (owner) — due 2w
  - Jorge M: Console dashboard mock + alerting spec (owner) — due 2w
  - Ben - Product: billing e2e plan & test cases (owner) — due 3w
  - Evelyn C: list of early opt-ins & contract asks (owner) — due 1w
  - Legal: signoff thresholds for grace windows >60d (owner) — pinged
ops-bot: Preview deploy created for feature/quotas-softguard (build #842). Test preview URL: https://preview.redwood.internal/quotas-softguard
Ben - Product: We'll reconvene after the dashboard mock and the prototype. Thanks all.
